chunks: The day you will turn your backs and flee, with none to defend you against God. Whoever God allows to go astray has none to show him the way.
ai.seo_question: Who protects the disbelievers on the Day of Judgment when they flee?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the transition from divine guidance to divine abandonment, illustrating how those who reject the Imams and Prophets find themselves without a 'Wasi' (heir/guide) on the Day of Resurrection. It underscores the concept of *Tawhid* in action, where God's decree of *Dalal* (misguidance) is a consequence of human choice, leaving them with no intercessor or protector other than Allah Himself.
